source.snippet: Like so many other SWEs right now, I am trying to find ways to enhance my development experience without taking away from the quality of my work or the things I find enjoyable about software engineering... I have found (what I think at least) is a maximum of productivity and enjoyment by primarily using Opencode as a pair programmer and wrangling out the general structure of the solution...

problem_statement: Software engineers want to integrate AI coding assistants into their workflow in a way that preserves code quality and personal craftsmanship, but lack structured guidance, workflows, or tooling to do so effectively without feeling like they are losing ownership of their work.
target_segment: Professional software engineers at companies of all sizes who use AI pair-programming tools (Opencode, Copilot, Cursor, etc.) and want structured productivity workflows
notes: Post has 4 points and replies — real engagement. Buyer context: professional SWE likely at a company paying for AI tooling subscriptions. Pain is workflow/methodology, not missing a free feature. A paid course, tool, or workflow product could address this. Signal is single post so strength kept at 2.
